book.name: MWANDUSO
book.title: KITABU CHA ICHANDUSO CHA MUSA KIKEMIGWA MWANDUSO

content: Lagano da Mulungu na Ablam
Abaho usenga wa MNDEWA umwizila Ablam muinzozi, wolonga, “Sambiudumbe, Ablam! Nie nokwimiliza, nhunza yako yowa ng'hulu ng'hani.”
Ila Ablam kalonga, “MNDEWA Mulungu, nhunza yaki inogile yondaunigwelele? Kwavija nie nabule mwana, na muhazi wa ng'anda yangu iyo Eliezeli munhu wa Damaski.
Kwavija hunigwelele wana, avo nyakadala imwe yali mng'anda yangu iyo yondayawe muhazi wangu.”
Abaho usenga wa MNDEWA umwizila mwanza wa ikabili, ulonga, “Nyakadala ino Eliezeli hawa muhazi wa mali gako, ila mwanago mwenyego iyo yondayawe muhazi wako.”
MNDEWA kamsola kamulava hanze, kamulongela, “Lola uchana kuulanga, uzipete zinhondo kamba uhadaha. Avo, vino vivo lukolo lwako vondaluwe.”
Ablam kamtamanila MNDEWA, na sama ya nhamanila yake, MNDEWA kampeta heyo kamba kabule uzenzeleganye.
Abaho kamulongela, “Nie iyo MNDEWA nikulavile kulawa isi ya Ulu, ikalile isi ya Wakaldayo, nikugwelele isi ino iwe yako.”
Ila Ablam kalonga, “Gweye, MNDEWA Mulungu, novitangaze kamba isi ino yowa yangu?”
Avo MNDEWA kamulongela, “Nigalile bogwa wa ng'ombe yali na milao midatu, bogwa wa menhe yali na milao midatu, na songolomi wa ng'hondolo yali na milao midatu, hamoja na hua na nziwa.”
Ablam kawagala wang'onyo wano wose ha Mulungu, kawakanha nyenza mbilimbili na kuzika mminhongo mibili, na kila lwenza lukiilola na miyage. Ila ndege kawachinja ila hawakanhile mzinyenza.
Vimhungu waihumulukila imitufi, ila Ablam kawawinga.
Zua vidiswile, Ablam kawasa utulo kakuluza, ziza na bwembe vimgubika.
MNDEWA kamulongela, “Uvitange kamba lukolo lwako lowa wahenza muisi ya wanhu wayagwe. Ako wowa nyakadala na wotendeligwa gehile mkipigiti cha milao mia nne.
Ila nousuna undewa uja wondauwatende hewo wawe nyakadala, abaho wolawa na mali bwando.
Ila gweye koilumba hamoja na wahenga zako mditindiwalo kuno uli na milao bwando.
Mulelo wa ikane wa lukolo lwako wobwela hano na kutawala isi ino, kwavija kipigiti kino Waamoli bado hawanatenda vilozo vivikile hanhu ha hewo kutagusigwa.”
Zua vidiswile na kilo vikingile, nongo dilava yosi na wenge da moto ukwaka vibita hagatigati ya izinyenza za izinyama.
Mdizua dija MNDEWA katenda lagano na Ablam, kamulongela, “Nowagwelela lukolo lwako isi ino, kulawa lwanda lwa Misili mbaka Lwanda lwa Yuflati,
isi ya Wakeni, Wakenizi, Wakadimoni,
Wahiti, Wapelizi, Walefai,
Waamoli, Wakanaani, Wagiligashi, na Wayebusi.”
